rules.name: Target Timeframe Adherence
rules.statement: The system must classify an order as fulfilled only if the total elapsed time from Order Request creation to Delivery Proof confirmation does not exceed the committed target window.
rules.condition: When an order reaches the Delivery Proof confirmation stage
exceptions: Force majeure events declared by the Regulatory Authority
Customer-initiated order cancellation prior to handover
rules.if_violated: The order is flagged as 'Late' and triggers a service credit workflow for the Customer and a penalty assessment for the Delivery Partner
rules.rationale: This ensures the core value proposition of ultra-fast delivery is maintained and SLAs are met

parameters.name: committed_target_window
parameters.description: The maximum allowed duration in minutes for order fulfillment

rules.name: Service Area Activation Prerequisite
rules.statement: The system must prevent the creation of a new Order Request if the associated Service Area Definition is not in an active state.
rules.condition: When a customer or partner initiates an Order Request
exceptions: Emergency override protocols authorized by the Platform Operator
System maintenance windows explicitly approved by the Regulatory Authority
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is rejected immediately and the user is notified that the service zone is unavailable
rules.rationale: This prevents orders from being accepted in zones where logistics or regulatory compliance are not verified

parameters.name: active_state
parameters.description: The status indicating the Service Area Definition is operational

rules.name: Delivery Partner Performance Threshold
rules.statement: The system must suspend a Delivery Partner's ability to accept new assignments if their on-time delivery rate falls below the minimum acceptable threshold within a rolling evaluation period.
rules.condition: When a Delivery Partner completes a batch of deliveries
exceptions: Temporary suspension due to verified force majeure events
New partner probationary period grace window defined in contract
rules.if_violated: The Delivery Partner is automatically removed from the active pool and must undergo a re-qualification audit
rules.rationale: This maintains service quality standards and protects the brand reputation for speed

parameters.name: minimum_acceptable_threshold
parameters.description: The minimum percentage of on-time deliveries required to remain active

parameters.name: rolling_evaluation_period
parameters.description: The time window used to calculate the delivery performance rate

rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Consistency
rules.statement: The system must invalidate an Order Request if the real-time inventory snapshot indicates that any selected item is unavailable at the assigned Store Partner.
rules.condition: When an Order Request is submitted for processing
exceptions: Manual override by a Store Partner manager for high-priority customer orders
System latency tolerance window defined in the SLA agreement
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is rejected to prevent overselling and subsequent refund disputes
rules.rationale: This ensures accurate inventory synchronization and prevents fulfillment failures due to stock discrepancies

parameters.name: real_time_inventory_snapshot
parameters.description: The current stock level data for all items in the order
